card.name: Indonesian place names and their regions
card.fires_on: Small linking words, commas and region words right after an Indonesian town or district, and parts of Indonesian place names, in travel or news text about Java, Borneo and Maluku.

modes.label: Link after a place
modes.description: A word such as of, in or a comma that follows an Indonesian district or town and leads into a larger region.
modes.example: It first erupted on 29 May 2006 in the Porong subdistrict<< of>> Sidoarjo in Eastern Java,

modes.label: Region word
modes.description: Region words like East, Eastern or central that come before Java or Borneo.
modes.example: near Lake Buret in Tulungagung,<< East>> Java; a green fashion show in Korea

modes.label: Inside place names
modes.description: Partway through an Indonesian village or island name.
modes.example: farmers in<< Sek>>onyer village, central Borneo

card.writes: It seems to push toward the next part of an Indonesian place name, such as ng, Dem or hari-type endings.
card.plain: It lights up when the text is moving from an Indonesian town to its province or island.
